site.proof: My Messenger assistant serves **43 Facebook Pages** from a single webhook and handles **14,100 executions an hour** at peak. It has held conversations with **4,394 people**, **46,822 messages** in all.

cases.title: Messenger AI assistant
cases.dek: A multi-tenant conversation assistant for Facebook Pages, built on n8n with Redis and PostgreSQL.
cases.problem: People send several messages in a burst. Most webhook deliveries are receipts and echoes, not messages. And Meta retries the delivery if the acknowledgement is slow.
cases.built: Acknowledge first, and drop the noise cheaply. One database statement elects a “leader” per sender; the leader waits 25 seconds, then answers the whole burst in one reply. The reply comes from an AI agent with conversation memory. Scheduled follow-ups run with error logging: 2,680 delivered.
cases.note: The public repository is a structure-only export and is not runnable.

flow.caption: One webhook delivery, left to right. Receipts and echoes leave at the first check; everything else is acknowledged before any work is done.

cases.aside: Demo. The clinic in it is fictional.
cases.title: Clinic AI receptionist
cases.dek: Answers questions, checks real availability and books appointments in chat. The booking appears live on the reception dashboard about 50 ms later.
cases.problem: A patient should be able to ask a question, see real availability and book, all in one chat, and reception should see the booking straight away.
built: The model can only act through **4 tools**, each validated on the server.
Double booking is impossible, by a database constraint.
Phone numbers never reach the model.
A booking reaches the dashboard in about **50 ms**.
cases.stack: Python, FastAPI, SQLite, OpenAI tool calling, Docker, nginx

cases.title: StoryForge
cases.dek: A pipeline that turns a story idea into vertical animated shorts rendered in Blender, 45–90 seconds per part.
cases.problem: A story idea has to become a finished, rendered vertical video, part after part, without redoing work every time one step changes.
cases.built: **17 cached stages** take the idea from screenplay to final video. **12 automatic quality gates** run before the final render. The pipeline has **78 tests**.

about: I studied computer science at the Faculty of Computer Science in Iași (BSc, 2024). Since then I’ve been building automation on my own: AI assistants and content pipelines that run in production, on infrastructure I set up and maintain myself.
I like understanding how a whole system fits together, and I judge what I build by its numbers: messages answered, bookings made, hours saved. I speak Romanian, English and French.
